_about: MPC-9884: hosts that appear in code but are never contacted by a visitor's browser or by our servers. Kept SMALL on purpose: XML/JSON-LD namespaces and reserved example names. A host that is actually fetched belongs in recipients.json, not here. Every line needs a reason. link_properties are object keys whose URL value is a citation or a navigation link shown to a person (a documentation source, an href), not a request; an <a href> in JSX is exempt for the same reason.
